comment: The qemu-wasm engine and the migration snapshot, built out of band (docs/engine.md) and published to this repository's `engine` release. Pinned by hash so `nix build .#site` produces the whole deployable tree, engine included.
guestComment: The guest image vm.state was captured from. A snapshot holds that kernel and initramfs in its RAM, so a guest built from different sources will not resume against it; checks.snapshot fails when these drift. Retake the snapshot (docs/engine.md) and update these together.
